Game Overview

At its heart, Highway Kiss Racer is a runner game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Highway Kiss Racer is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Highway Kiss Racer?

Highway Kiss Racer is a free runner game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Highway Kiss Racer free to play?

Yes, Highway Kiss Racer is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
